<b>船位对齐</b> 把大船画回它真正占的格子: Hull alignment Draw big ships on the tiles they actually occupy
<color=#aaaaaa>游戏算船视图偏移的那个函数**只读宽度、不读长度*: <color=#aaaaaa>The engine's ship view-offset function **reads width only, never length**, and caps out at half a cell — just enough for the vanilla 1×2 frigate (which is why vanilla is correct at every heading), but one cell short for 2×4 and two cells short for 3×6. The result: the ship is drawn ahead of the cells it actually occupies, so the bow cell can't be clicked while a phantom cell appears off the stern. The offset is derived from hull size (one cell sternward per two cells of length, one cell to starboard per two cells of width); the cruiser and grand cruiser values were reverse-engineered from live measurements, so it lines up out of the box. **Only changes where the hull is drawn, never which cells it occupies** — pathfinding and targeting are untouched. Frigates and raiders keep vanilla behaviour.</color>
